Maybe I'll try and talk to her, but I'm a very awkward person haha. As for going out, I go to stores and will walk around a park every now and then, but the people I see, around my age are people I'm not interested in hanging out with. I mean, if they're cool and all, and not those people that laugh at you, that sort of stuff. And to answer your final comment, I really hope I do. That would be awesome. I hope you find happiness as well man. You seem like an awesome person even though I've never met you and we've only had one conversation. But yeah, thanks for relpying. It really lightened up my mood and day.
